Heard learned counsel for the appellant and learned APP for the State.
2. Records have been placed before this Court to consider the prayer of the appellant for suspension of his sentence and release on bail during pendency of the appeal.

3. The appellant has been convicted vide judgment dated 23.01.2024 and sentenced vide order dated 25.01.2024 in connection with POCSO Case No. 16 of 2023 (CIS No. 16 of 2023) arising out of Laxmipur P.S. Case No. 129 of 2023 by the learned District & Sessions Judge-1-cum-Special Judge S.C/S.T & POCSO Act, Jamui for the offence under Sections 376(3) and Patna High Court CR.
APP (DB) No.224 of 2024(13) dt.02-12-2025 506 of the Indian Penal Code (in short 'IPC') and under Section 4(2) of the Protection of Children from the Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act.

sentences.text: 4. Learned counsel for the appellant submits that in this case, the age of the victim has not been properly determined and the learned trial court seems to be have relied upon a school leaving/transfer certificate showing her date of birth as 20.06.2008.
It is submitted that the medical test for assessment of age could not be conducted because the victim refused to undergo medical examination.
5. On the other hand, learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State submits that this appellant is the sole accused in this case.

He had repeatedly committed rape on the victim as a result whereof,
the victim had conceived and on the date of her medical examination she was found carrying a pregnancy of about 23 weeks.

6. Having regard to the submissions noted Patna High Court CR. APP (DB) No.224 of 2024(13)
dt.02-12-2025 hereinabove, in view of the statements of the prosecutrix and her medical condition showing that she had become pregnant and was carrying pregnancy of 23 weeks at the time of her medical examination and she has attributed this to the appellant alleging repeated sexual intercourse with her, we are not inclined to grant privilege of suspension of sentence and release on bail during pendency of the appeal.
8. It is made clear that the observations made hereinabove are only prima-facie and tentative for the purpose of suspension of sentence and bail which would not cause prejudice to the either parties.
9. If the appeal is not listed for hearing within one year from today, the appellant will be at liberty to make an application for early hearing of the appeal.

(Rajeev Ranjan Prasad, J) (Sourendra Pandey, J) aditya/-
